Manistee County Special Discounts & Coupons
Hello and welcome to the Manistee County blog for special discounts, deals, coupons and promo codes. Usually we would limit these coupon codes to local residents, but now we are opening the discounts to the entire world through our world wide web portal.
For those of you that don’t know where Manistee County is, we are located in Northern Michigan a good deal above Grand Rapids. Our county is named after the Manistee River. We may not be the largest county in Michigan, and certainly not the largest in the USA, but our 25,032 residents enjoy saving money when shopping online just as much as the rest of them.
